name: Moeve
description: We want to guarantee the energy of today while working ambitiously to transform the energy and mobility of tomorrow.
longDescription:
Moeve, formerly known as Cepsa, is redefining energy and mobility as it strides towards a sustainable future. With over 90 years of innovation and economic contribution, Moeve is committed to transforming the energy landscape by investing up to €8 billion in initiatives that include green hydrogen, second-generation biofuels, electric mobility, and sustainable chemicals. The company is set to become a leader in Europe’s green energy sector, exemplified by projects like the Andalusian Green Hydrogen Valley—the continent’s largest green hydrogen initiative.

Moeve positions itself as a catalyst for change, focusing on providing clean energy solutions while ensuring environmental sustainability. Its diverse product offerings encompass marine fuels, lubricants, and aviation fuels, alongside advancements in innovative clean energy technologies. With a mission to foster sustainable mobility and to reduce carbon footprints, Moeve is dedicated to making a positive impact on the world, solidifying its status as a pioneer in the intersection of energy and technology.
